description: This dashboard has charts displaying Application Load Balancer, llm-d EPP, vLLM, and GPU networking metrics for GKE Inference Gateway and llm-d stacks on GKE.

text.content:
### Charts
#### Application Load Balancer Metrics

* Tracks the request rate and latency of external and internal regional Application Load Balancers.
* Refer to the [Cloud Load Balancing metrics documentation](https://cloud.google.com/load-balancing/docs/metrics) for the complete list of metrics.

#### llm-d EPP Metrics
* Tracks the health and performance of the llm-d Endpoint Picker (EPP), including inference objective, inference pool, prefix indexer, and plugin metrics.
* Refer to the [llm-d Router (EPP) metrics documentation](https://llm-d.ai/docs/operations/observability/router-metrics) for details on the underlying metrics.

#### vLLM & GPU Networking Metrics
* Tracks GPU networking throughput/latency and vLLM model server performance (including Prefill/Decode disaggregation roles).
* Refer to the [llm-d observability documentation](https://llm-d.ai/docs/operations/observability/setup) for metric collection setup.

widget.title: Inference Pool Average KV Cache Utilization

sectionHeader.subtitle: Tracks the request and latency of external and internal application load balancers.
To apply the cluster filter to networking metrics, use the `goog-k8s-cluster-name` label in the filter section.

timeSeriesQuery.prometheusQuery:
label_replace(
  group by (metadata_system_node_name, pod_name) ({"__name__"="kubernetes.io/container/uptime","monitored_resource"="k8s_container","pod_name"=~".*(vllm|sglang|decode|prefill|worker).*"}),
  "node",
  "$1",
  "metadata_system_node_name",
  "(.+)"
)
* on (node) group_left ()
(
    label_replace(
        sum by (metadata_system_name)(
            avg_over_time({"__name__"="compute.googleapis.com/instance/gpu/throughput_tx_bytes","monitored_resource"="gce_instance"}[1m])/1m
        ),
        "node",
        "$1",
        "metadata_system_name",
        "(.+)"
    )
    / on (node)
    count by (node) (
      label_replace(
        group by (metadata_system_node_name, pod_name) ({"__name__"="kubernetes.io/container/uptime","monitored_resource"="k8s_container","pod_name"=~".*(vllm|sglang|decode|prefill|worker).*"}),
        "node",
        "$1",
        "metadata_system_node_name",
        "(.+)"
      )
    )
)

label_replace(
  group by (metadata_system_node_name, pod_name) ({"__name__"="kubernetes.io/container/uptime","monitored_resource"="k8s_container","pod_name"=~".*(vllm|sglang|decode|prefill|worker).*"}),
  "node",
  "$1",
  "metadata_system_node_name",
  "(.+)"
)
* on (node) group_left ()
(
    label_replace(
        sum by (metadata_system_name)(
            avg_over_time({"__name__"="compute.googleapis.com/instance/gpu/throughput_rx_bytes","monitored_resource"="gce_instance"}[1m])/1m
        ),
        "node",
        "$1",
        "metadata_system_name",
        "(.+)"
    )
    / on (node)
    count by (node) (
      label_replace(
        group by (metadata_system_node_name, pod_name) ({"__name__"="kubernetes.io/container/uptime","monitored_resource"="k8s_container","pod_name"=~".*(vllm|sglang|decode|prefill|worker).*"}),
        "node",
        "$1",
        "metadata_system_node_name",
        "(.+)"
      )
    )
)

sectionHeader.subtitle: Monitor the health and performance of the llm-d Endpoint Picker (EPP)

timeSeriesQuery.prometheusQuery: sum by (error_code, model_name, target_model_name) (rate(llm_d_epp_request_error_total[${__interval}])) or on() vector(0)
